preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree and the restriction on moving up are within the specified bounds.
Each parent vertex is within the range of vertex indices.

preconditions.expression: The input represents a valid tree rooted at 1
preconditions.description: The tree structure is valid and has a root at vertex 1.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum number of different leaves that can be visited.

invariants.expression: The token can move down to any leaf in the subtree of the current vertex or move up to the parent no more than k times.
invariants.description: The token's movement options are defined by the problem statement.
